scope: tasks.json against the three pinned implementation files

groundedRequiredClauses.clause: retry-controller state, operation invocation/success/failure, callback order, budget/count stopping, AbortError, timer and retry loop

correction.clarification: Keep the existing 'limits of cancelling an already-running caller operation' wording. It is factually grounded only if authors make clear that pRetry awaits input(attemptNumber) without passing the signal or installing an abort listener for that promise; an abort is observed before/after the await and during retry waiting, so it does not itself interrupt an input already running.

groundedRequiredClauses.clause: two maps/current count/expiry policy and non-persistent ownership
new-current insertion increments count; threshold rotates generations and emits evictions for the previous old generation, rather than removing one LRU item
old-generation get promotes only non-expired entries; has/peek do not promote; expiry invokes callback then delete; explicit delete/clear have no callback invocation

tasks.hiddenExpectationRisk: none found: the task expressly distinguishes rotation from single-item eviction and callbacks from delete/clear.

corrections.replaceClauseFragment: Show the meaningful search decisions for missing/unreadable candidates...
corrections.with: Show the meaningful search decisions for candidates whose fs.access fails (skip and continue), and distinguish a later fs.promises.readFile failure from a normal search miss because it propagates. Also cover empty files and ignoreEmptySearchPlaces, and package.json/packageProp extraction; do not imply every discovered package.json is a matching configuration.
corrections.reason: The current word 'unreadable' conflates caught access failures with uncaught read failures. The separate error clause currently names explicit-load read failures but omits search read failures.
corrections.source: src/index.js:192-228; specifically access catch at 194-198 and uncaught read at 199

corrections.replaceClauseFragment: Preserve error propagation for loader/parse/transform failures and explicit-load read failures...
corrections.with: Preserve error propagation for loader/parse/transform failures and read failures in both search and explicit load; distinguish them from a normal search miss.
corrections.reason: search invokes fsReadFileAsync outside the access try/catch, so its read errors reject search.

groundedRequiredClauses.clause: separate search/load caches hold transformed results only when cache is enabled; each clear method addresses its named cache
search stops after checking stopDir/root; package.json only succeeds when packageProp is non-null; empty search files may be skipped
explicit load validates/selects loader, reads separately, and returns a transformed empty result rather than a search-style skip
